name: com.landtakeoffs/takeoffs
title: Land Takeoffs
description: Sitework takeoffs from civil PDFs, DWG, LandXML: cut/fill, storm, sewer, water, paving quantities

tools.name: start_takeoff_from_chat_files
tools.title: Start a takeoff from files attached in the chat
tools.description: Starts a sitework takeoff from a plan-set PDF and/or CAD files the user attached to this chat, when the app passes those attachments into the tool (ChatGPT). plan_set is the plan-set PDF. cad_files lists the CAD drawing first, then any drawings it references (for example a survey DWG). Same credits as start_takeoff. An ambiguous CAD file returns a question that answer_cad_question accepts. Returns a takeoff_id; get_takeoff_status reports progress. Files that are only on the user's computer are outside this tool; get_upload_link returns a private upload link for those.

cad_files.description: The attached CAD drawing, then any drawings it references.

project_name.description: Project name for the bid sheet.

strip_depth_in.description: Topsoil strip depth in inches, if the user knows it.

shrink_pct.description: Shrink, bank to compacted fill, percent, usually in the geotech report. Omit and no shrink is applied (labeled).

topsoil_reuse_pct.description: Share of stripped topsoil placed back as fill, percent.

pavement_section_depth_ft.description: Pavement section (asphalt plus base) depth, feet.

storm_rcp_class.description: Class for concrete storm pipe the drawing does not label. Fills only unlabeled pipe.

water_pvc_type.description: Type for PVC water pipe the drawing does not label.

price_list.description: Optional: the name of one of the user's saved price lists (list_price_lists). Prices go in the Excel workbook only.

annotations.title: Start a takeoff from files attached in the chat

tools.name: list_price_lists
tools.title: List saved price lists
tools.description: Returns the names of the user's saved unit-price lists. A name supplied as price_list on a start tool prices that takeoff's Excel workbook only. The PDF summary does not include prices.

tools.name: check_balance
tools.title: Check credit balance
tools.description: Returns how many takeoff credits the account has left, purchased, and used, plus the current credit pack prices. Use it to answer pricing questions.

tools.name: start_takeoff
tools.title: Start a takeoff (CAD file, plan set, or both)
tools.description: Starts a complete sitework takeoff from up to 2 files: a CAD file (DWG, DXF or LandXML) and a civil plan-set PDF. Each file is a share link (Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, or a direct https link). With both, earthwork is measured from the CAD and everything else is read from the plans, in one report. Drawings the DWG references, such as a survey, go in cad_reference_urls. Uses 1 credit, plus 1 per plan-set pages over 100, charged only if it succeeds. If the CAD is ambiguous, the result is a question with options that answer_cad_question accepts. Returns a takeoff_id; get_takeoff_status reports progress.

cad_file_url.description: Share link to the DWG, DXF or LandXML.

cad_reference_urls.description: Share links to drawings the CAD file references (xrefs), for example a SURVEY.dwg that holds existing ground.

plan_set_url.description: Share link to the plan-set PDF.

project_name.description: Project name for the bid sheet.

strip_depth_in.description: Topsoil strip depth in inches, if the user knows it.

shrink_pct.description: Shrink, bank to compacted fill, percent, usually in the geotech report. Omit and no shrink is applied (labeled).

topsoil_reuse_pct.description: Share of stripped topsoil placed back as fill, percent.

pavement_section_depth_ft.description: Pavement section (asphalt plus base) depth, feet.

storm_rcp_class.description: Class for concrete storm pipe the drawing does not label. Fills only unlabeled pipe.

water_pvc_type.description: Type for PVC water pipe the drawing does not label.

price_list.description: Optional: the name of one of the user's saved price lists (list_price_lists). Prices go in the Excel workbook only.

tools.name: start_plan_set_takeoff
tools.title: Start a plan-set takeoff
tools.description: Starts a complete sitework takeoff from a civil plan-set PDF. plan_set_url is a share link (Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, or a direct https link that anyone with the link can open). Uses 1 credit per 100 pages, charged only if it succeeds. Returns a takeoff_id; get_takeoff_status reports progress.

plan_set_url.description: Share link or https URL of the PDF.

project_name.description: Project name for the bid sheet.

customer_ref.description: Optional tag for the user's own client or job number.

price_list.description: Optional: the name of one of the user's saved price lists (list_price_lists). Prices go in the Excel workbook only.

tools.name: start_cad_takeoff
tools.title: Start a CAD earthwork takeoff
tools.description: Starts a measured earthwork takeoff from CAD or terrain files (LandXML, DWG, DXF, GeoJSON boundary). file_urls are share links to every file. If the files are ambiguous (for example two possible site boundaries), the result is a question with options that answer_cad_question accepts. Uses 1 credit, charged only if it succeeds.

file_urls.description: Share links or https URLs of the CAD or terrain files.

project_name.description: Project name for the bid sheet.

strip_depth_in.description: Topsoil strip depth in inches, if the user knows it.

shrink_pct.description: Shrink, bank to compacted fill, percent, usually in the geotech report. Omit and no shrink is applied (labeled).

topsoil_reuse_pct.description: Share of stripped topsoil placed back as fill, percent.

pavement_section_depth_ft.description: Pavement section (asphalt plus base) depth, feet.

storm_rcp_class.description: Class for concrete storm pipe the drawing does not label. Fills only unlabeled pipe.

water_pvc_type.description: Type for PVC water pipe the drawing does not label.

price_list.description: Optional: the name of one of the user's saved price lists (list_price_lists). Prices go in the Excel workbook only.

tools.name: answer_cad_question
tools.title: Answer a CAD takeoff question
tools.description: Records the user's answer to a question from start_cad_takeoff or start_takeoff: the chosen site boundary, or which surface is existing ground and which is proposed grade. Starts the takeoff once nothing else is pending.

tools.name: get_takeoff_status
tools.title: Check takeoff progress
tools.description: Reports whether a takeoff is downloading, queued, running, finished, or failed. Accepts the takeoff_id from a start tool, or a job_id.

takeoff_id.description: takeoff_id returned by a start tool.

job_id.description: A job_id, if one is already known.

tools.name: get_takeoff_results
tools.title: Get takeoff quantities
tools.description: Returns the quantities from a finished takeoff, grouped by division, with the source sheet or file and a confidence level for each line, plus the lines that could not be determined and why. Accepts the takeoff_id from a start tool, or a job_id.

takeoff_id.description: takeoff_id returned by a start tool.

tools.name: get_download_links
tools.title: Get Excel, PDF, video and image downloads
tools.description: Creates and stores the client Excel bid sheet and PDF summary for a finished takeoff and returns download links for them, plus the project video, project images, and a download-all zip. Starts that render when it has not already started. Image and video files are deterministic renders of the takeoff geometry and report figures, not AI-generated media. Links expire after a short time; a later call returns fresh ones. Accepts the takeoff_id from a start tool, or a job_id.

takeoff_id.description: takeoff_id returned by a start tool.

annotations.title: Get Excel, PDF, video and image downloads

tools.name: list_takeoffs
tools.title: List recent takeoffs
tools.description: Returns the account's recent takeoffs, newest first, with their status.

tools.name: get_upload_link
tools.title: Get a private upload link
tools.description: Returns a private upload link when the plans are files on the user's computer or a share link fails. The link is valid for 24 hours, good for one takeoff, and needs no sign-in and no chat file-size limit. The user drops the plan-set PDF, the CAD file, or both, plus any drawings the CAD references (such as a survey DWG). Apps that support MCP Apps also show an upload card in the chat. Returns a takeoff_id; get_takeoff_status reports progress.

project_name.description: Project name for the bid sheet.

strip_depth_in.description: Topsoil strip depth in inches, if the user knows it.

price_list.description: Optional: the name of one of the user's saved price lists (list_price_lists). Prices go in the Excel workbook only.

tools.name: get_upload_page
tools.title: Upload plans on the website
tools.description: Returns the signed-in account page, where the user can upload files and see every takeoff. A one-takeoff upload of local files is the private link from get_upload_link.

resources.name: upload_card
resources.title: Upload plans
resources.description: Drop the plan set and CAD files for a takeoff without leaving the chat.
